title: Primo block config.yaml
description: Schema for blocks/{name}/config.yaml. Holds the block's stable system ID and display label. Reserved for future block-level metadata (description, icon, category, etc.).

$schema.description: Optional editor IntelliSense pointer. Ignored by import.

_id.description: System-owned block ID. Keep existing IDs stable; omit this when creating a new block.

name.description: Human-readable block name shown in the editor. Editing this does not rename the folder or move references.
